item.title: Thesis Proposal
item.description:
I am currently in the literature review stage before my thesis proposal:

  • Systematically tracing the development from mean-variance analysis to robust / distributionally robust portfolio optimization
  • Organizing classical papers and recent advances into a review framework
  • Drafting the thesis proposal; working papers in preparation

Toolchain: LaTeX (writing), Python / MATLAB (numerical experiments), Obsidian (literature notes).
